result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional `description`, and it comes back in all the listings and the code lookup you named. The full suite passes (608 tests, build succeeded).

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`, so older promotions have none. The 200-character limit is my choice; tell me if marketing needs a different length.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` is the last record component. It's null when none was given.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new 6-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. A null or blank description is stored as null. The existing 5-argument method is kept and delegates with no description, so current callers don't change.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the INSERT writes the description, and the six promotion queries (by code, active on date, active in region, by category, best for category, unused in period) select it and map it into the record.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: one new test. It creates SUMMER with the description and PLAIN without, then checks the description in each listing and in the code and best-promotion lookups.

I didn't commit anything.
